title: Average visible Earth fraction
description: Time-average of Earth's centre being above the local LOLA terrain horizon (direct-to-Earth line of sight). Period-dependent (daily / monthly / 2026-2030).
method: LOLA LDEM_64 horizons + SPICE DE440 Earth vector in MOON_ME (LT+S, parallax). See pipeline/moonsite/earth_global.py.
